data.one_liner: An emoji picker widget for Flutter with multiple categories, search, and skin tone support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable emoji picker widget with 1500+ emojis across 8 categories, search functionality, skin tone options, and localization support. It integrates directly with a TextEditingController to insert emojis into text fields.
use_when: You are building a chat application or comment section that requires an emoji input picker.
You need a configurable emoji selector supporting custom fonts and search.
avoid_when: You do not need an emoji input interface in your app.
strengths: Lightweight and fast loading with built-in caching for supported glyphs.
Completely customizable including views, layouts, and skin tone management.
Supports Material Design and Cupertino modes, along with localized languages.
weaknesses: Platform compatibility filtering is restricted to Android only.
Custom emoji fonts can introduce performance issues on iOS.
data.setup_notes: No special setup or permissions required; depends on shared_preferences for recent emojis and skin tone persistence.
